candidates.requirement: Exercise the new depth rejection in the target's json_dump_callback or json_dumps operation. A finite witness is a JSON array value constructed with JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH + 1 nested arrays and passed to either dump operation.
candidates.target_route: The entry currently takes a value only from json_loadb, then calls one of two dump modes. The parser limits value depth before either mode runs.
candidates.failure_condition: Parsing rejects a value beyond the parser limit, while every successfully parsed value has fewer nested edges than the depth needed to execute do_dump's new guard. The entry never constructs a deeper value.
candidates.alternative_paths: Both dump modes delegate to the same do_dump call at depth zero. Load flags do not bypass parse_value's depth check, and the complete entry has no construction path. The added dump API test demonstrates a supported constructed-value route.
